name: Jörgen Warborn - Article 2 – alinéa 1 – point 10; Article 33 – alinéa 2  - Am 59
title: REPORT on the proposal for a directive of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Directives 2006/43/EC, 2013/34/EU, (EU) 2022/2464 and (EU) 2024/1760 as regards certain corporate sustainability reporting and due diligence requirements
section: Article 3 – paragraph 1 – point 2 – point b – point ii
part_text: (ii) to issuers as defined in Article 2(1), point (d) of Directive 2004/109/EC which are parent undertakings of a large group which, on its balance sheet dates, exceed the average number of 5000 employees and a net worldwide turnover of more than EUR 450 000 000, on a consolidated basis, during the financial year;’;
